verifications.claim: The NASA Artemis II mission successfully launched on Wednesday, April 1, 2026, at 6:35 p.m. EDT from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis II lifted off at 6:35 p.m. EDT.' 'Kennedy Space Center in Florida'; R2: 'blasted off from Florida on Wednesday evening... at 6:35 p.m. Eastern time. ... verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the exact date (April 1, 2026), day (Wednesday), time (6:35 p.m. EDT), and location (Kennedy Space Center, Florida).

verifications.claim: The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket carried four astronauts into orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission around the moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'From launch... to splashdown on April 10, the mission is slated to last about nine and a half days'; R2: '10-day mission'; R3: 'approximately 10-day Artemis II mission around the Moon'; R4: '10 days in space'; R5: 'ten day mission'; R6: 'set to spend 10 days in space, orbiting the Earth once before flying to the moon, around it and back'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources describe it as a ~10-day mission looping around the moon; minor variation (9.5 vs. 10) is approximate and consistent.

verifications.claim: The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket launched successfully from Launch Complex 39B.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'launching from... Launch Complex 39B'; R3: 'lifted off from Kennedy Space Center’s Launch Complex 39B'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm successful SLS launch from LC 39B.

verifications.reasoning: Post-launch updates confirm Orion is in Earth orbit performing maneuvers shortly after launch.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew will travel around the moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'loop around it, getting an unprecedented view of the far side of the moon'; R2: 'take astronauts around the moon but not land there'; R3: 'approximately 10-day Artemis II mission around the Moon'; R4: 'journey around the moon'; R5: 'fly around the Moon'; R6: 'flying to the moon, around it and back'
